text: Connection loss recovery: freeze new actions, reconcile outstanding external state, verify canonical state, recover the session, then resume.
Reconciliation procedure: read external state, compare local and external state, resolve differences, mark reconciliation complete, then verify outstanding state is clear.
Service recovery: verify current state, satisfy recovery policy, restart only when authorized, then verify service health.
Resume workflow: require connected session, complete reconciliation, healthy service, and clear outstanding state before resuming operations.
A previous disconnect incident was resolved by reconciling external state before recovering the session. Restarting before reconciliation was avoided.
